leadText:
The Castle of Chivalry (Japanese: 騎士道の館 Hall of Chivalry) is an -exclusive location located in the Kalos region. Wikstrom of the Elite Four uses it to coach Pokémon and Trainers who desire true strength. It appeared in Searching for Chivalry!.
 
Upon learning of the Castle of Chivalry, and Goh traveled there with and , respectively, to get some coaching from Wikstrom. The coaching session consists of three challenges: running ten laps around the castle, making it through a booby-trapped maze called the Labyrinth of Doubt (Japanese: 不安的迷宫 Maze of Doubts), and fighting Wikstrom and his while trying to retrieve a key from his . The Trainers and Pokémon who pass all three challenges are rewarded with Knight Medals.

Ash and Goh managed to pass the challenges and received Knight Medals. Afterwards, Wikstrom helped Goh evolve his Scyther into by giving it a Metal Coat and transferring it through a trade machine.

The location was mentioned again in Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to be a Leek Master!, where Rinto revealed that he and his had trained there as well.

In The Future is Now, Thanks to Strategy!, Wikstrom was seen having a brief battle with Drasna at the castle.
